stem.text: A projectile is thrown at an angle to the ground.

stem.alt: Curved projectile path rising from a grey ground strip; at one point on the path a horizontal arrow labelled 23.0 m s-1 and a downward arrow labelled 10.1 m s-1 are drawn; labels: projectile path, ground.

stem.text: At a certain time, the projectile has a horizontal velocity of $23.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ and a vertical velocity of $-10.1\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the speed of the projectile at this time?
